item.description: 📆 Top News Today 🚩 Moving forward confidently: Russian troops liberated the settlements of Chervonaya Krinitsa and Novopavlovka in Zaporozhye region. 💥 Striking combo: the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation delivered a massive strike with high-precision weapons and long-range attack UAVs at enterprises of military-industrial and fuel-power systems in Kiev and Kiev region, as well as infrastructure facilities in Odessa, Odessa region, the ports of Odessa and Chernomorsk used to store and deliver military supplies, fuel and lubricants for the Armed Forces of Ukraine. ▫️ Every enemy's stronghold requires it's own 'corkscrew': the commander of the assault company with the call sign 'Max' told how Russian servicemen uncovered and destroyed large fortifications of the enemy in Zaporozhye region. ▫️ Mastering the Science of Victory: the Defence Minister of the Russian Federation Andrei Belousov congratulated academic staff, students, cadets, and officers of military educational institutions on Knowledge Day and on the beginning of a new academic year. In educational institutions of the Ministry of Defense across the country, ceremonial rallies were held to mark the beginning of the new academic year. We remember that strength lies in truth and knowledge! #TopNews 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ▫️ Experience of special military operation and loyalty to calling: academic year starts in Military Medical Academy branch
item.description: ▫️ Experience of special military operation and loyalty to calling: academic year starts in Military Medical Academy branch 🤝 Russian Deputy Defence Minister Anna Tsivileva congratulated cadets and instructors of a branch of the Military Medical Academy named after S.M. Kirov on the beginning of the academic year stressing that military medics are the real elite of the Army. ▫️ A high level of teaching, combined with real combat experience, helps to prepare officers and medical personnel for modern combat conditions. It raises the prestige of the entire military service. ⏩ The fact that more than 30% of those who entered the Academy this year are participants of the special military operation plays a huge role. Moreover, it is not only the future medical officers who have the combat experience, but also those who have come to secondary and junior medical school. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 📐 Profession of special importance: the legendary Military Technical University is back in St. Petersburg
item.description: 📐 Profession of special importance: the legendary Military Technical University is back in St. Petersburg 🤝 On Knowledge Day, the Deputy Russian Minister of Defence Pavel Fradkov inspected the readiness of the re-established Military Engineering-Technical University and congratulated its cadets. 💬 Pavel Fradkov stressed that great prospects for service to the benefit of the Fatherland lay ahead of them, and their professionalism would directly strengthen the country's defence capabilities. More than 400 people entered the university in 2026. The cadets will undergo training at 21 modern training complexes. ▫️ Godspeed, future engineers! 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

Mastering Science of Victory. Keep going! Taking advantage of the innovations and experience of the special military operation to the maximum!

This year, more than 800 cadets have been enrolled in the first year, more than 100 of whom are participants of the special military operation.

the experience of combat operations during the military training is maximally implemented in the educational process.

the training of cadets began at the pilot training cluster deployed at the school
with a system of information interaction and situational awareness of officials in the tactical management unit
"SVOD"
.

item.content:encoded:

▫️
The legendary Moscow Higher Combined Arms Command School rightfully gets the Guards status!
Minister of Defence Andrei Belousov attached Ribbon of Saint George to the banner of Moscow Higher Combined Arms Command School. Since now, Russian legendary Higher School has officially turned into the Guards Higher School.
💬
Addressing to cadets, teachers, and veterans of the school,
Andrei Belousov noted that this title is
not just a status, but
more than a century of living history, heroism, courage and loyalty of thousands of his graduates, whom our country is proud of.
👉
The head of the Ministry of Defence congratulated the cadets and recalled that
‘the Guards status is not only a great honour, but also a serious responsibility’
📆
Moscow Higher Combined Arms Command School is rightfully called legendary. Its history is full of heroic pages.
At the beginning of October 1941, the cadets regiment took part in the fiercest battle for Moscow in Volokolamsk direction. For the heroism and courage shown in those battles, 59 cadets and 30 officers were awarded orders and medals. To conmemorate heroes, a memorial board was opened on the main building of the School.
📊
Over the entire history of the school, five Marshals and over 600 Generals studied here. Nearly 150 graduates awarded the title of Hero of the Soviet Union and the Russian Federation. The school itself was awarded four times with government awards.
▫️
Andrei Belousov
laid flowers at the monument to the "Kremlin Graduates"
and paid tribute to the memory of the servicemen who gave their lives during the military duty performance.
▫️
Today, the Moscow Guards Higher Combined Arms Command School
is one of the country's leading military educational institutions, that has a glorious history and glorious future.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 🤝 Today, Deputy Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation Colonel General Vitaly Shulika congratulated cadets and academic staff of the Military Academy for Information Securit
item.description: 🤝 Today, Deputy Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation Colonel General Vitaly Shulika congratulated cadets and academic staff of the Military Academy for Information Security named after Army General S.M. Shtemenko. 📆 This academic year is symbolic for the Academy. Just recently, on July 1, 2026, the legendary Krasnodar Higher Military School was granted the status of Military Academy. This is where unique cyber security specialists study in the interests of Russian army and foreign colleagues. 💬 For Vitaly Shulika, this institute is special; he graduated in 1992. item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/29152

🤝
Today, Deputy Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation Colonel General Vitaly Shulika congratulated cadets and academic staff of the Military Academy for Information Security named after Army General S.M. Shtemenko.
📆
This academic year is symbolic for the Academy.
Just recently, on July 1, 2026, the legendary Krasnodar Higher Military School was granted the status of Military Academy. This is where unique cyber security specialists study in the interests of Russian army and foreign colleagues.
💬
For Vitaly Shulika, this institute is special; he graduated in 1992. After presenting state awards to officers,
the Deputy Minister held the first lecture for first-year cadets.
Vitaly Shulika told cadets about the importance of the Fatherland's defender profession.
✅
He stressed that
‘the development of military education and the improvement of the quality of military personnel formation
is one of our priorities today’.
▫️
The Ministry of Defence continues to implement a long-term
large-scale project 'Military education in the service of the Fatherland'
, which is aimed at improving the military education system, widespread introduction of innovations, creating a comfortable educational environment, and strengthening the prestige of military service.
📚
At the end, Vitaly Shulika
wished the cadets luck in mastering science and achieving their goals.
▫️
Comrades, study hard, make your dreams come true confidently and remember:
the future of our Motherland is in your trusted hands!
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry
